instructions.name: advance_epoch
docs: Advance to the next epoch. Requires all markets in the current epoch
to be settled. Unpauses the epoch gate for the new epoch.

accounts.name: prev_epoch
docs: Previous epoch — must be fully settled before we can advance.

accounts.name: buyer_base_ata
docs: Buyer's base token account (source of payment after swap)

accounts.name: treasury_base_ata
docs: Treasury's base token account (receives payment)

accounts.name: buyer_outcome_ata
docs: Buyer's outcome token account (receives shares)

accounts.name: outcome_mint
docs: The outcome token mint

instructions.name: claim_paused_bet
docs: Refund a user's original stake when the protocol is paused.

instructions.name: close_epoch
docs: Manually close an epoch and enable LP withdrawals.
Normally auto-triggered when the last market in the epoch settles.

accounts.name: epoch
docs: Epoch account for the current epoch — must match global_config.current_epoch.
Markets are always created under the active epoch so the epoch can track
how many markets need to settle before LP withdrawals are unlocked.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can call expire — they receive the PDA rent.

accounts.name: epoch
docs: Epoch the market belongs to. Must match market.epoch_id.
Updated here to track settled-market count and unlock LP withdrawals
once all markets in the epoch are settled.

instructions.name: init_epoch
docs: Create the on-chain Epoch account for the current epoch.
Must be called before any markets can be created in a new epoch.

instructions.name: pause_epoch
docs: Pause epoch — blocks deposits, withdrawals, and market creation.
Admin can pause at any time (e.g. between epochs or for emergency).

accounts.name: epoch
docs: Epoch account for the current epoch. Withdrawals are only permitted
once all markets in the epoch have settled (withdrawals_enabled == true).

instructions.name: unpause_epoch
docs: Unpause epoch — re-enables deposits, withdrawals, and market creation.

types.name: DisputeStatus
docs: Lifecycle of an oracle-proposed result.
No public challengers — admin can override within the challenge window.

types.name: Epoch
docs: Tracks the state of an epoch — a time-bounded period during which
markets are created and settled. LPs can only withdraw after their
epoch's markets have all settled.

types.name: LimitOrder
docs: A peer-to-peer limit order for outcome tokens.
Sell orders: creator locks outcome tokens in escrow at placement.
Buy orders:  creator locks USDC collateral in treasury at placement.
Either side can be partially filled. The creator can cancel at any time
to recover locked assets. Anyone can expire an order past its deadline.

types.name: MarketMode
docs: Controls whether LMSR share trading is exposed directly to users.
`FixedOdds` — LMSR is an internal pricing engine only. Users interact via
`place_slip` / `cash_out_slip`. Direct `buy_shares` / `sell_shares` calls
are rejected. This is the default for sports markets.
`Trading` — LMSR is fully exposed. `buy_shares` / `sell_shares` are
permitted. Intended for prediction markets, not sports.

types.name: OrderSide
docs: Which side of the order book the creator is on.

types.name: OrderStatus
docs: Lifecycle state of a limit order.

types.name: PendingLiquidity
docs: Tracks LP shares that are minted but locked until activation_time.
Shares count toward total_lp_supply from deposit time (invariant-safe),
but cannot be used for withdrawal until the activation delay passes.
